technicalChangesRequired: Explicit exploratory train-only mode in existing preparer/trainer: no validation split or best-validation checkpoint; retain all dog/source isolation and approval checks.
Mode-specific approval for source-movie PTS and partial-paw class coverage; preserve native-timing and full-cohort requirements for measured evaluation.
Explicit source physical-paw mapping in pair import: existing importer reads A/B for both pairs, while S004 forepaws are C/D. Preserve original records and hashed remapping provenance.
Human-verified continuous identity span is needed for a multi-frame supervised window; sparse V3 endpoint observations alone do not establish it.
